info.name: Google Chrome Management App Details Telemetry Events API

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. Maximum value is 1000.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token to specify next page in the result set.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter to restrict results. Supports filtering by event type, device, user, and timestamp.

params.name: readMask
params.description: Fields to include in the response. Supported event types: audioSevereUnderrunEvent, usbPeripheralsEvent, networkStateChangeEvent, httpsLatencyChangeEvent, wifiSignalStrengthEvent, vpnConnectionStateChangeEvent, appInstallEvent, appUninstallEvent, appLaunchEvent.

items.docs: Lists telemetry events for a customer. Events include USB peripherals added or removed, audio severe underrun, network state changes, hardware status changes, and other device-level events. Events are retained for a limited time.
